university.name: University of Dundee
university.summary: The University of Dundee is based in Dundee, Scotland, and its courses listed here are taught at the Dundee City Campus. Its Pakistan page states it has agreements with local recruitment agents registered with the British Council. Its scholarships are partial fee reductions, not full funding.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.duration_text: 4 or 3 years; a year in industry is available through the Industrial Placement variant
courses.overview: A computing degree taught at the Dundee City Campus, entered at Level 1 over four years or, where entry requirements allow, over three years, with core modules in software development, artificial intelligence and a final year Honours Project.
courses.academic_requirements: September 2027, Scottish Highers for the 4-year course starting at Level 1: BBBB standard, BBCC widening access, with a STEM or technical subject at Higher essential. A level and IB requirements are not shown.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall: writing 6.0, listening 5.5, reading 5.5, speaking 5.5. PTE Academic UKVI 64 overall (writing 64, others 59). TOEFL iBT 80 overall (writing 19, listening 17, reading 18, speaking 20).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The course entry requirements page lists Pakistan in its country selector but shows no Pakistan-specific requirements. The Pakistan page directs applicants to choose Pakistan from the I am from list on course pages.
courses.notes: Fee page shows date of entry September 2027 and gives no academic year label; fee is the international fee before scholarships. Module levels were inferred from module codes and page order. Pakistan-specific entry requirements are not visible. Fee of 19,450 is below the 21,800 programme fee threshold of the undergraduate Vice Chancellor's South Asia scholarship.

courses.title: Business Management
courses.overview: A business degree taught at the Dundee City Campus, with four, three or two year entry routes depending on prior qualifications, and placements and internships described on the course page.
courses.academic_requirements: September 2027, Scottish Highers: 4 years (Level 1) BBBC standard, BCCC widening access; 3 years (Level 2) BC at Advanced Higher plus BB at Higher. A level and IB requirements are not shown.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall: writing 6.0, listening 5.5, reading 5.5, speaking 5.5. PTE Academic UKVI 64 overall. TOEFL iBT 80 overall (writing 19, listening 17, reading 18, speaking 20).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The course entry requirements page lists Pakistan in its country selector but shows no Pakistan-specific requirements, and says applicants who do not meet the grade requirements can consider International College Dundee routes.
courses.notes: Fee page shows date of entry September 2027 and gives no academic year label. The course page says a January start may be possible. Module names are not shown. Pakistan-specific entry requirements are not visible. Fee of 19,450 is below the 21,800 programme fee threshold of the undergraduate Vice Chancellor's South Asia scholarship.

courses.title: Computer Science
courses.tuition_academic_year: Not labelled (entry dates January 2027 to January 2028)
courses.overview: A 12 month full-time conversion master's at the Dundee City Campus designed for non-computing graduates, whose degree can be in any subject.
courses.academic_requirements: A UK Lower Second-Class Honours (2:2) degree; the course is designed for non-computing graduates, so the degree can be in any subject.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall: writing 6.0, listening 5.5, reading 5.5, speaking 6.0. TOEFL iBT 87 overall (writing 20, listening 17, reading 18, speaking 22). PTE Academic UKVI 69 overall (each skill 64).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The entry requirements page shows only the UK undergraduate degree requirement and no Pakistan-specific route. The Pakistan page directs applicants to choose Pakistan from the I am from list on course pages.
courses.career_notes: The course page lists roles including software engineer, data analyst and UX designer.
courses.notes: The fee page lists three entry dates with one fee of 23,700 per year of study (before scholarships) and no academic year label; it does not say which entry date the figure applies to, and another page states fees may rise each January. Module names are not shown.

courses.title: Management
courses.tuition_academic_year: Not labelled (entry dates January 2027 to January 2028)
courses.overview: A 12 month full-time master's at the Dundee City Campus covering strategic management, leadership, human resource management and project management, with an eight week internship matched to the student's industry.
courses.academic_requirements: A UK Honours degree at third-class or above, in any subject which has enabled the development of analytical and quantitative skills.
courses.english_requirements: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall: writing 6.0, listening 5.5, reading 5.5, speaking 5.5. PTE Academic UKVI 64 overall. TOEFL iBT 80 overall (writing 19, listening 17, reading 18, speaking 20).
courses.pakistan_entry_note: The entry requirements page shows only the UK undergraduate degree requirement and no Pakistan-specific route, and mentions International College Dundee for applicants who do not meet the academic grade requirements.
courses.career_notes: The course page describes progression in a current job, leadership roles or starting a business, and an eight week internship.
courses.notes: The fee page lists three entry dates with one fee of 23,700 per year of study (before scholarships) and no academic year label; it does not say which entry date the figure applies to. Module names are not shown; the page lists seven separate management pathway degrees.

scholarships.name: Vice Chancellor's South Asia Postgraduate Scholarship (September 2027)
scholarships.summary: A partial fee reduction for full-time on-campus taught master's applicants domiciled in South Asia, including Pakistan, who hold an offer and international fee status. No separate application is needed.
scholarships.criteria_text: Pakistan is listed as an eligible country. Offer for a full-time, on-campus postgraduate taught master's with a programme fee of GBP 19,900 or above; international fee status confirmed in the offer letter. Exclusions are in the Key Facts and Terms and Conditions documents.
scholarships.deadline_note: Deadline listed as Monday 11 October 2027 at 23:59 UK time; start date given as 11 September 2027.
scholarships.notes: Page does not say whether the GBP 2,000 applies once or each year, so value_basis is null. The page refers to 2026-27 terms and key facts documents, which seems inconsistent with a September 2027 intake. The deadline falls after the stated start date as published.

scholarships.name: Vice Chancellor's South Asia Undergraduate Scholarship (January 2027)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 6,500 in the entry year and GBP 4,000 for any subsequent year of study for up to 5 years (maximum total GBP 22,500)
scholarships.summary: A partial fee reduction for full-time on-campus undergraduate applicants domiciled in South Asia, including Pakistan, who hold an offer and international fee status. No separate application is needed.
scholarships.criteria_text: Pakistan is listed as an eligible country. Offer for a full-time, on-campus undergraduate programme (excluding Medicine and Dentistry) with a programme fee of GBP 21,800 or above; international fee status.
scholarships.deadline_note: Deadline listed as Saturday 30 January 2027 at 23:59 UK time; intake date 11 January 2027.
scholarships.notes: The South Asia undergraduate scholarships list on the university site shows no September 2027 award for South Asia; only a January 2028 award (GBP 2,000) whose own page could not be opened and whose listed deadline is 30 January 2027.
